text: The one breaking change this week is #13172 in BCApps: Agent Task gains public GetTaskLogEntryDetails overloads, the record-based GetLogEntryDetails method is removed, and AI Eval run data can be exported in structured form. Other behaviour changes cluster in a few areas. Expense Agent got #13721, which creates per diem lines on approval, plus #13569, #13504, #13182 and #13184, while #12985, #13185, #13460 and #12910 fix submission, rounding, filter and email validation problems. Sales Order Agent and AI features moved to GPT-5.6 in #13495 and #13506. Posting and finance fixes include #13547 and #13417 for return orders and sales order quantities, #13396 for partial purchase invoicing, #13459 and #13488 for additional reporting currency, #13397 for Indian depreciation, and #13642 for work descriptions on prepayments. #11256 adds setup options for restoring order quantities on returns, both on by default. Quality Management received validation fixes in #13428, #13429 and #13427. Localization fixes cover French payment slips (#11596, #13472), Belgian Intervat (#13481, #13484) and Swiss SEPA exports (#13273, #13301). In AL-Go, #2440 and #2433 fix release artifact selection and versioning strategy 3. #13725 reduces repeated reads in inventory cost adjustment, and #13065 and #9527 open E-Document objects to extension.

issues: #13427 asks for confirmation before finishing a re-inspection rather than adding validation, so 'validation fixes' fits #13428 and #13429 better than #13427.

#13725, #13065 and #9527 are not flagged as behaviour changes. They come after the sentence 'Other behaviour changes cluster in a few areas', so a reader could take them for behaviour changes. They are described correctly, though.
#13182 and #13184 are the same 'View rules' link change on two branches (Master and 29.x). The paragraph lists them without saying what they do, which is acceptable but less informative.
